excerpts.author: sauliusgrigaitis
excerpts.content: Hi, great work, but I’m also wondering why not all the clients were tested? If for some reason a large number of nodes per client is not acceptable then maybe just a few nodes of every client would be possible next time? These tests and results is something that clients teams can’t do themselves so it would be very valuable for every team to be included.
